result.summary: Found 1 issue: a performance/loading problem where a restaurant image is stuck in a loading state with a spinner overlay.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing shows a circular loading spinner over the food image, indicating the content is not fully loaded. This creates a broken visual experience where users cannot see the actual restaurant dish image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images are properly preloaded or provide a fallback placeholder image while content loads. Consider optimizing image loading to reduce loading times and prevent spinner overlays from appearing in the main content area.
